title: Regex Atlas — Pattern Workbench
description: A regex workbench: live match highlighting, railroad diagrams, plain-English explanations, replace preview and a saved test suite.
concept: Regex Atlas turns a regular expression into something you can actually see. Type a pattern and it compiles live: matches light up in the test subject with every capture group tinted its own colour, a hand-written recursive-descent parser builds an AST, and that AST is laid out as an SVG railroad diagram you can tap to jump to the matching slice of the pattern. The same AST drives a plain-English breakdown, so a wall of brackets reads as sentences. Fourteen presets, a replace-preview with $1/$<name> expansion, and a persistent pass/fail test suite make it a tool rather than a demo.
features: Live compile with match highlighting and per-capture-group colour tinting
SVG railroad diagram from a hand-written recursive-descent regex parser — tap any node to select it in the pattern
Plain-English explanation tree generated from the same AST
Replace preview with $1, $&, $`, $' and $<name> expansion, plus apply-to-subject
Persistent test suite — assert must-match / must-not-match per string, with a live pass count
14-pattern preset library and a click-to-insert cheatsheet
Export the whole workbench as JSON, copy the pattern as JS + Python, or share it as a URL
tech: SVG railroad layout engine (measure + draw pass)
RegExp d flag / match.indices for exact group spans

interaction.mouse: Type a pattern and test subject; click a match row to select it in the subject; click a diagram node to select its source slice.
interaction.click: Toggle the six regex flags, switch Diagram / Replace / Tests / Cheatsheet tabs, load presets, insert cheatsheet tokens, Share / Export / Copy code.
interaction.touch: Fully tappable — the layout stacks to a single column, tabs scroll horizontally and the diagram pans.
interaction.keyboard: Enter adds a test case; Enter in the pattern field is suppressed so the expression stays one line.
